messages:
trina: starting promotion of auth-gateway chart -> trying canary in us-west. deploy-bot reports CRD install mismatch on canary controller.
deploy-bot: preflight failure: CRDVersionMismatch: cluster has CRD authpolicies.v1beta1, chart expects v1. Suggest: (A) apply CRD migration, (B) pin chart to previous stable that supports v1beta1, or (C) rollback. Canary paused.
sam: hmm our chart bump included CRD schema fields (rateLimit.enabled) that the cluster CRD doesn't accept yet. We should avoid forcing a cluster CRD update during canary window.
marco: +1 pin the chart. We can do CRD migration in maintenance window with DB and platform oncall.
release-manager: agree. Plan: pin to chart v2.6.8 for now, update release notes explaining deferred CRD migration and schedule migration for 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC (low traffic).
ops-oncall: if we pin, ensure we set a chart-digest lock and annotate to prevent auto-promote. Also add a feature flag on ingress for gradual switch.
trina: commands I'll run to pin and resume safe rollout:
```
# pin to previous chart revision and image digest
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease auth-gateway \
  release.redwood.io/chart-pin="auth-gateway@2.6.8" --overwrite
helm upgrade auth-gateway ./charts/auth \
  --version 2.6.8 --set image.digest=sha256:feedface --namespace prod
```
marco: add the promotion-block annotation too so CI won't try to re-promote newer charts automatically:
```
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease auth-gateway \
  release.redwood.io/promotion-block=true --overwrite
```
sam: I'll prepare the CRD migration manifest and a canary-ready apply script that will run in the maintenance window. Will post as gist and link to the follow-up ticket.
release-manager: release notes entry: "Auth-gateway chart promotion pinned to 2.6.8 due to cluster CRD version mismatch; CRD migration scheduled 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. No functional regression expected; security fixes included in later chart will be backported if urgent."
deploy-bot: annotation chart-pin / promotion-block applied. Canary remains paused. Incident record created: crd-mismatch-1781239999. Rollback command if needed: `helm rollback auth-gateway <prev-revision> --namespace prod`.
ops-oncall: verifying smoke tests after pinning... all endpoints OK in us-west canary subset.
trina: thanks — posting follow-up ticket RDW-530 with CRD upgrade plan, validation playbook, and rollback steps. Assigning to platform and infra.
marco: one more note: when applying CRD migration in maintenance window, run `kubectl apply --server-side -f crd-v1.yaml` and validate on staging first.
sam: linking gist with migration script: https://gist.github.com/sam/abcdef1234. Also added validation steps: `kubectl get crd authpolicies -o yaml | grep schema`.
release-manager: marking this release as "manual promotion required" until RDW-530 closed. Updating changelog and notifying product.
trina: thanks all. Will monitor until maintenance window. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident logged and workflow created. To clear block after migration: `kubectl annotate helmrelease auth-gateway release.redwood.io/promotion-block=false` then `deploy-bot promote --chart auth-gateway --revision latest`.
